Name: Infinite Money - Galaxilli Pipo
Author: GalaxilliPipo
Description:
[b][size=6]Infinite Money[/size][/b]
[size=5]Description[/size][size=4]
This mod maintains the player's gold at the maximum capacity. It is designed to be a lightweight solution for removing financial constraints from the gameplay.
Features[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Wealth Persistence:[/b] Automatically restores gold to the maximum limit (99,999,999g) every game tick.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Instant Recovery:[/b] Any gold spent at shops or received from shipping is immediately reset to the maximum value.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Configurable:[/b] Settings can be toggled or adjusted via the Generic Mod Config Menu.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=5]Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]SMAPI[/b] - Stardew Modding API[/size][/*]
[*][b][size=4]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][size=5]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Ensure both [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] are installed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Download this mod and extract the folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Place the folder into your[/size]

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][size=4]directory.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Run the game through SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=5]Technical Details[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6+.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Multiplayer:[/b] Compatible. The mod only affects the player who has it installed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Save Safety:[/b] Can be installed or uninstalled on existing save files without issues.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=5]Credits[/size]
[size=4]Developed by [b]GalaxilliPipo[/b]. Technical issues and bug reports should be submitted via the "Bugs" or "Posts" section.[/size]
